entfernt.satz: The formulas beyond $w=61$ remain a conjecture, and a proof for general odd $w$ is open.
The constants are given there for weight up to 9 [C-modular-R7a], and $g_9$ appears there as an integration constant [C-modular-R1d].
entfernt.grund: Quantor/Verallgemeinerung ohne Allaussage im zitierten Claim; sage „at the points examined (...)“ oder streiche den Quantor

entfernt.satz: - Remark 1 states as a conjecture that the closed forms extend beyond $w=61$; they are proved up to $w=61$ [C-fakt-konstanten].
entfernt.grund: Quantor/Verallgemeinerung ohne Allaussage im zitierten Claim; sage „at the points examined (...)“ oder streiche den Quantor

entfernt.satz: Exact rational computation in the algebraic Laplace representation gives $\Delta X_w=w(w-1)f_wE(w)$ with no other terms, re-done for the odd weights up to 61 [C-modular-R17a].
entfernt.grund: Quantor/Verallgemeinerung ohne Allaussage im zitierten Claim; sage „at the points examined (...)“ oder streiche den Quantor

entfernt.satz: The combinations $X_w$ for odd $w$ are due to DGV (their eq. 3.57), $f_w$ up to weight 9 and $g_w$ for $w=3$ and $w=5$ appear in their eq. 3.34, and $g_7$ also appears in arXiv:2109.05017, eq. 3.77 [C-modular-R17a].
entfernt.grund: Quantor/Verallgemeinerung ohne Allaussage im zitierten Claim; sage „at the points examined (...)“ oder streiche den Quantor

entfernt.satz: DGV state that the eigenvalue-0 eigenspace has multiplicity one at odd weight and zero at even weight; the closed form $f_w=3((w-1)/2)!/w$ is not given there, and the exact confirmation up to $w=25$ is an independent recomputation [C-modular-R14].
entfernt.grund: Quantor/Verallgemeinerung ohne Allaussage im zitierten Claim; sage „at the points examined (...)“ oder streiche den Quantor

entfernt.satz: Criterion 2 was preregistered afterwards on new data (20 points, seed 4713, $\tau_2\in[0.9,3]$, threshold 1e-16) and passed [C-fakt-kriterium1], [C-modular-R12].
The weight-11 identity was tested at 8 points (seed 9001, including $\tau$ near $\rho$ and $\tau_2$ up to 3), preregistered (H10) with 8 points planned and 8 completed [C-fakt-haertung].

entfernt.satz: - *Weight 11.* A numerical integer-relation search over the full basis of 12 elements, with 6-8 points and up to 64 digits, found no relation [C-neg3].

story.kernfrage: What are the closed forms of the constants f_w and g_w in the identities X_w = f_w E(w) + g_w zeta(w) between the DGV combinations X_w of dihedral modular graph functions and E(w), for odd weight w?
story.kernaussage: For every odd weight 3 <= w <= 61, the D'Hoker-Green-Vanhove combination X_w of dihedral modular graph functions satisfies X_w = f_w E(w) + g_w zeta(w) exactly, with f_w = 3((w-1)/2)!/w and g_w = 6|B_{w-1}|/((w-1)/2)!.
story.titel: Closed forms for the constants in the odd-weight identities between dihedral modular graph functions
story.keywords: modular graph functions, dihedral graphs, non-holomorphic Eisenstein series, Laplace equation, Bernoulli numbers, closed-string one-loop amplitude
